metadata.name: delivered-work-signal
metadata.description: Phase C.2 — delivered work W as an explicit low-pass state, per ADR 0003. W tracks the real goods flow through the transaction and decays toward it, so it falls when delivery falls. Feeds M/W in C.3. No kernel change: the tap works because compute_derivatives pins sources, constants and processing nodes to dQ/dt = 0, so a parallel edge off a pinned origin costs that origin nothing.

_mechanism: The goods flow is F = k x Q_seller x Q_buyer, computed by the exchange node. Edge w_tap reproduces exactly that expression as an interaction edge originating at `seller`. Because `seller` is a source, its derivative is zeroed regardless, so the tap does not double-debit the supply. W then leaks at beta through w_leak, giving dW/dt = F - beta x W, which settles at W = F/beta and follows F down as trade slows.
_limitation: The tap duplicates the flow EXPRESSION (k and control) rather than referencing the edge it mirrors, so changing k on the real path without changing it here silently desynchronises W. A referencing mechanism belongs with b2-coupled-edge-live, which would make coupled_edge live. The tap is also only free when its origin is pinned: off a storage origin it would double-debit.

nodes._note: Delivered work. Settles at F/beta and falls as F falls.
